summary: Tested session-3 features (backend+frontend). Partial roll return (API+UI), budget summary (API+UI incl. 390px), GRN photo->auto OCR read (real OpenAI) with draft for blind (warehouse@) and non-blind (admin) users all WORK. Campaign-bill notification for Finance had 2 bugs: (1) BACKEND notif link 'mkt-campaigns' is not an allowed screen for finance so notification_scope.relevance_filter HID it from finance's bell (FIXED by T1: link -> 'accounts-payable'); (2) FRONTEND inline approve button never renders for finance (ROLE_RANK in NotificationCenter.jsx lacks 'finance') - NOT fixed (static bundle needs rebuild). Also found data-integrity bug in partial return with duplicate roll ids (orphan child roll).

critical.issue: Notification created with link='mkt-campaigns'; finance has no marketing screen so GET /api/notifications filtered it out (relevance_filter by allowed_links) -> finance never saw it. FIXED by T1 in services/marketing_cost_service.py line 211: link='accounts-payable' (in finance allowed_links). Verified: finance /notifications now lists it. Main agent: confirm the target screen choice.

Non-atomic partial handling: partial=[{roll_id:A,qty:0.6*len},{roll_id:A,qty:0.6*len}] (duplicate roll) passes per-item validation, first split creates a child roll (status available, stock +qty, movement written), second split fails -> 409 'Roll berubah bersamaan', but the first child roll stays in warehouse with NO material_returns entry and NO GL WIP reversal -> stock vs WIP/ledger out of sync. Same applies if whole-roll move succeeds then a later cut fails. Fix: reject duplicate roll_ids across roll_ids+partial (400) and validate sum per roll before mutating; ideally do all validation first / compensate on failure. Reproduced 2x (tests/test_session3_extended_t1.py::test_partial_mixed_and_duplicate).

minor.issue: sales@ gets 200 (has marketing.view) - confirm intended. Campaigns without start_date and created_at contribute to total_budget but to no month bucket.

Earlier comm04 tests leave orphan campaign_bill_approval notifications (VB-00012/13 TEST_COMM04E) after deleting campaigns/bills - finance bell shows stale items. Add notifications cleanup to those tests (and/or mark read/delete notification when bill/campaign removed).

ui_bugs.issue: Inline 'Setujui' button never rendered for campaign bill notifications: canActOn(userRole, n.action_role='finance') uses ROLE_RANK={sales,warehouse,manager,admin}; 'finance' missing -> required rank 99 -> false for finance AND admin. Fix e.g. canActOn = userRole===requiredRole || rank(user)>=rank(required) (don't just give finance rank 2, that would expose PO approve). Also button title says 'Setujui PO langsung' for bills. Requires rebuilding static bundle.

Partial qty input silently falls back to WHOLE roll when value is invalid/>=remaining/0/typo (partQty returns null) - user typing 30 for a 28.34 roll or '1O' returns the entire roll without warning. Show inline validation or block submit.

integration_issues.flow: Finance approves campaign bill from bell

Backend approve via /api/vendor-bills/{id}/approve by finance works and marks notification read.

rca of the issue: Finance notification invisible: services/notification_scope.relevance_filter requires notification.link in allowed_links(user); finance's allowed links (108) include 'accounts-payable' but not 'mkt-campaigns'. Inline approve missing: NotificationCenter ROLE_RANK has no 'finance' key -> canActOn('finance','finance') = 0 >= 99 false. Orphan child roll: per-item validation reads the same parent length for duplicate entries; split 1 mutates, split 2 guard fails -> HTTPException after side effects, no rollback.
